articles.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
articles.snippet: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

articles.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
articles.snippet: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
articles.snippet: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

articles.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
articles.snippet: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.
